Click an item
behaviour: Clicking an item selects it alone and moves the focus to it.

label: Ctrl-click an item
behaviour: Ctrl-clicking an item adds it to the selection or takes it out, and moves the focus to it.

label: Shift-click an item
behaviour: Shift-clicking an item selects every item from the focused one to it, in view order.

label: Drag over empty space
behaviour: Dragging from empty space draws a translucent rectangle and selects every item it touches; with Ctrl held it adds to the selection.

label: Item check boxes
behaviour: With View, Show, Item check boxes on, each item shows a check box on hover and while selected; clicking it adds or removes the item, and the details header gains a select-all box.

label: Select all
behaviour: Selects every item in the view.

label: Invert selection
behaviour: See more, Invert selection selects exactly the items that were not selected.

label: Focus against selection
behaviour: Selected items carry the accent fill; the focused item carries a focus rectangle, shown once the keyboard is used, whether or not it is selected.

label: Rename in place
behaviour: F2, or a second click on a selected item, opens its name for editing in place with the name selected up to the extension; Enter keeps the new name, Esc restores the old one.

label: Click a column header
behaviour: Clicking a column header sorts by it, ascending, with an arrow over the header; a second click sorts descending.

label: Drag a column edge
behaviour: Dragging the edge between two headers resizes the column on its left; a double-click on the edge sizes it to fit its widest value.

label: Drag a column header
behaviour: Dragging a header along the row moves its column, with a marker where it lands.

label: Drag image
behaviour: Dragging items shows their icons under the pointer with a count badge for several, and a tip naming the operation (Move to, Copy to, Create link in) and the target.

label: Drop highlight
behaviour: A folder in the list or an entry of the navigation pane under a drag takes the hover fill; resting on a collapsed navigation entry expands it.

label: Sort and Group by menus
behaviour: The command bar's Sort menu and its Group by submenu are recorded with the frame (explorer/frame.json, sort-menu); the grouped scene is this view grouped by type.

label: Group header row
behaviour: A group's header row shows its name in the accent text colour with a collapse chevron at its left and no item count (the grouped shot); the chevron collapses the group to its header.
